slides.title: Not Growing Weary — Galatians 6:9 and Philippians 1:6

items.text: At the Rhythm week this verse was a warning; tonight, on the far side of a break, it is a receipt — you did not give up. You are here
“And I am sure of this, that he who began a good work in you will bring it to completion at the day of Jesus Christ.” — Philippians 1:6 (ESV)
The not-giving-up is not white-knuckling: the work being completed in you is His. He began it; He finishes it
“Our rhythm is not the engine — it is the showing-up that keeps us where the engine is running.”
The last re-entry of the year — look how fast the room came back. That is what it looks like when the practices start belonging to you

panel.label: GALATIANS 6:9 (ESV)
lines: “And let us not grow weary of doing good, for in due season we will reap, if we do not give up.”

items.text: One sentence each, full circle — a harvest reading, not an examination
“What held from your card across the break — or what slipped and got begun again?”
Holds and slips are both good news tonight — both mean the card is real and you are reading it honestly
A parent starts; brisk and warm; pass-anytime holds — laughter is allowed and likely
“In September that round would have taken an hour and a crowbar. The practices are yours now.”
Week 19 — our Companions-in-Formation teach the two mercy cards — the Signs Card and the Path Home Card — in your clusters
Week 20 — The Long Walk: the seniors teach the whole room; journals come along, and the testimony gathering begins
Week 21 — Sending and Blessing: whole families, a longer evening — two hours, 7:00 to 9:00
Week 22 — the Commissioning of the Companions, in front of everybody who watched them grow
Hear the shape of that list: week by week, the people up front stop being us and start being you
The sentence to keep: “the year now begins to hand itself over”
Run your Rhythm Card as built — nothing new, nothing extra; if the break knocked a piece loose, begin again on the next available day
The evening note, one extra flavor: note where you see God already handing pieces of this year over to you
For the parents, said once: the Four Questions door is still open — willing-only, whenever the moment is right; nobody will ever check. The questions keep
Bring your journal — and put Week 21's two hours on the calendar tonight
“One sentence for the road: you came back tonight like people who know the way — because you do now.”
“Five weeks to the sending. Let us not grow weary; the season is His, and it is nearly harvest.”
“See you Wednesday. Week 19 — the teens have the cards.”

panel.label: NUMBERS 6:24–26
lines: “The Lord bless you and keep you; the Lord make His face shine on you and be gracious to you; the Lord turn His face toward you and give you peace.”
